origin.says: 气 (gas) for the meaning plus 录 (a form of 彔, short for 绿 green) as sound and hint: chlorine, the 'green gas'. A 19th-century coinage.
Simplified from 箏: ⺮ (bamboo) for the meaning plus 爭 (strive, shortened to 争) as the sound: a long zither, first made with bamboo; also a kite.
白 (white) for the meaning plus 告 (tell) as the sound: shining white, bright.
白 (white, bright) for the meaning plus 完 (finish) as the sound: first "bright"; now an old place name and the short name of Anhui province.

Simplified from 粵, a variant of 雩 (rain prayer) with the rain top reshaped; Shuowen saw other parts. It was used for the Yue peoples of the south, and now for Guangdong and Cantonese. The modern shape no longer shows the build.
⺼ (flesh) for the meaning plus 夜 (night) as the sound: the armpit, a sense once written with 亦 (also) alone.

猬.def: porcupine, hedgehog; many, varied; vulgar, low

origin.says: 犭 (animal) for the meaning plus 胃 (stomach) as the sound: the hedgehog. The older form 蝟 had 虫 (creature) as its meaning part, swapped for 犭.

猬.name: hedgehog

origin.says: 文 (culture, refinement) next to 武 (martial): someone with both the civil and the military graces, so refined and elegant.
疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 豆 (bean) as the sound; the bean also fits the bean-sized pustules of the disease: smallpox, a pimple.
疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 利 (profit) as the sound: a disease of the bowels, 'dysentery'.

Oracle bones show two hands with a broom sweeping away dirt: refuse, dung. The traditional 糞 kept dirt bits (now 米, rice) over 田 and two hands; the 1956 simplification dropped 田, leaving 米 over 共 (together).
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 勃 (surging) as the sound: swelling water, now mainly the name of the Bohai Sea.

湃.def: turbulent, surging; the sound of waves crashing

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 拜 (bow) as the sound: the surge and crash of waves.

湃.name: surging waves

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 俞 (yes; a dugout boat) as the sound: first the name of a river, then 'to change'; today the short name of Chongqing.

渲.def: to render; to exaggerate, to embellish, to add layers of color

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 宣 (proclaim) as the sound: to wash ink or color in layers on a painting, to render, to exaggerate.

渲.name: color wash

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 咢 (shouting) as the sound: a startled heart, astonished.
穴 (cave, hole) for the meaning plus 告 (tell) as the sound: a pit or cellar for storing things.
穴 (cave, hole) for the meaning plus 君 (ruler) as the sound: hard-pressed, cornered, embarrassed, like someone stuck in a hole.

ety.hint: To pray 礻 alone 单; 单 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 禪: 示 (altar) for the meaning plus 單 (single) as the sound: first a sacrifice, then used for Sanskrit 'dhyana', meditation. 單 is simplified to 单.

絮.def: cotton padding; fluff, padding, waste; long-winded

origin.says: 糸 (silk) for the meaning plus 如 (as, like) as the sound: coarse silk floss used as padding, hence fluff.

絮.name: fluff

origin.says: Simplified from 緬: 纟 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 面 (face) as the sound, first a long fine thread, hence distant and to think back on. Only the silk radical was simplified.
Simplified from 纜: 纟 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 覽 (look over) as the sound, now 览: a thick rope, a cable.
Simplified from 緞: 糹 (silk) became 纟. 纟 (silk) for the meaning plus 段 (section) as the sound: 'satin'.
Simplified from 縷: 糸 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 婁 (Lou) as the sound: a single thread or strand. Both parts are shortened.

瑟.def: a large string instrument; to tremble, to vibrate

origin.says: 珡 (a stringed instrument) for the meaning plus 必 (must) as the sound: a large zither. The top 珡 later turned into the unrelated 玨 (two jades).

瑟.name: big zither

origin.says: 革 (leather) for the meaning plus 化 (change) as the sound: leather boots. It replaced the older form 鞾.
革 (leather) for the meaning plus 巴 as the sound: first a leather rein grip, later a target for shooting.
昔 (former times) as the sound plus 鸟 (bird) for the meaning: the magpie. Simplified from 鵲, with 鳥 (bird) written 鸟.
艹 (plants) for the meaning plus 浦 (shore) as the sound: the cattail or rush that grows by the water.
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 容 (contain) as the sound: the hibiscus or lotus; also a name for Chengdu.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 春 (spring) as the sound: the Chinese toon tree, a long-lived tree, used poetically for a father.

楷.def: the normal style of Chinese handwriting

ety.hint: The script 木 used by commoners 皆

origin.says: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 皆 (all) as the sound: first a tree name, then a model or pattern, and so the standard regular style of handwriting.

楷.name: model script

origin.says: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 鬼 (ghost) as the sound: the pagoda or locust tree.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 俞 (yes; a dugout boat) as the sound: the elm tree.
A modern coinage for the element iodine: 石 (stone, mineral) for the meaning plus 典 (canon) as the sound, from the first syllable of the English name.
目 (eye) for the meaning plus 疌 (quick) as the sound: eyelashes.

ety.hint: Leftover 奇 farmland 田; 奇 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 田 (field) for the meaning plus 奇 (odd) as sound and meaning: an odd leftover piece of field, hence irregular, abnormal.
𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 尧 (lofty) as the sound: to raise the foot, stand on tiptoe; stilts. Simplified from 蹺.
𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 朵 (blossom) as the sound: to stamp the feet.
虫 (insect) for the meaning plus 吳 (shouting man) as the sound: used in 蜈蚣 (centipede).

嗡.def: the droning sound made by an airplane or a bee flying

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 翁 (old man) as the sound: a droning, buzzing sound.

嗡.name: buzz

origin.says: 巾 (cloth) for the meaning plus 晃 (sway) as the sound: a cloth screen or a shop's cloth sign swaying at the door.
From 錨: 金 (metal) for the meaning plus 苗 (sprout) as the sound, a metal anchor. The simplified form uses the short metal sign 钅.
Simplified from 鑼: 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 羅 (bird net) as the sound: a metal gong. It uses 钅 and the simplified 罗.

锥.def: gimlet, drill, awl; to drill, to bore

origin.says: 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 隹 (short-tailed bird) as the sound: a metal awl. Simplified from 錐, with 金 written 钅.

锥.name: awl

origin.says: A modern coinage: 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 孟 (eldest) as the sound, echoing 'manganese'.
月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 思 (think) as the sound: the fleshy cheek and jaw, and a fish's gills. It replaces the older form 顋 with 頁 (head).
Simplified from 鵬: 鸟 (bird) for the meaning plus 朋 (friend) as the sound: a legendary giant bird. 鳥 became its cursive shape 鸟.
饣 (food) for the meaning plus 莫 (do not) as the sound: steamed bread. Simplified from 饃, with the food part written 饣.

ety.hint: Distilled 留 wine 饣; 留 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 餾: 食 (food) for the meaning plus 留 (stay) as the sound: to steam food again; now to distill. 食 is written 饣.

ety.hint: To show 示 something to an official 亠回

origin.says: First 㐭 (granary) plus 禾 (grain): handing out grain from the store, then to receive and to report to a superior. The variant now standard writes the bottom as 示 (show).

靖.def: to pacify, to appease; calm, peaceful

ety.hint: As peaceful 立 as nature 青; 青 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 立 (stand, establish) for the meaning plus 青 as the sound: to make stand firm, to pacify; calm.

靖.name: pacify

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 真 (true) as the sound: first the name of a lake (Dian Lake), now a short name for Yunnan province.
米 (grain) for the meaning plus the sound part of 梁 (bridge) (water + 刅 (wound)): a fine grain, millet or sorghum.

窥.def: to peep, to spy on, to watch

origin.says: From 窺: 穴 (hole) for the meaning plus 規 (rule) as the sound: to peep through a hole. 規 became its simplified form 规.

窥.name: peep

origin.says: 穴 (hole, cave) for the meaning plus 屈 (bend) as the sound: a cave or hollow, a den.
衤 (clothing) for the meaning plus 卦 (divination figure) as the sound: an outer jacket or robe.
纟 (silk) for the meaning plus 宾 (guest) as the sound: many-colored silks, hence abundant and varied. Simplified from 繽 (糹 to 纟, 賓 to 宾).

剿.def: to annihilate, to destroy, to exterminate

origin.says: 巢 (nest) as the sound plus 刂 (knife) for the meaning: to cut down, wipe out (bandits in their lair).

剿.name: exterminate

摹.def: to trace; to imitate, to copy; pattern

origin.says: 莫 (do not) as the sound plus 手 (hand) for the meaning: to copy by hand, to trace.

摹.name: trace copy

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 祭 (sacrifice) as the sound: first a kind of weed; borrowed for a large tortoise, an old state and a surname.
巸 (broad chin) as the sound plus 灬 (fire) for the meaning: bright and glowing, hence prosperous and splendid.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 容 (contain) as the sound: the banyan tree.

辗.def: to roll over; to turn on a side

origin.says: 车 (cart) for the meaning plus 展 (unfold) as the sound: a wheel rolling over, to turn over and over. Simplified from 輾 by writing 車 (cart) as 车.

辗.name: roll over
